name: log_destination
description: Specifies the destination(s) for PostgreSQL server log output, such as stderr, syslog, csvlog, or eventlog.
symptoms: Missing log entries in centralized logging systems
CSV log files not generated when csvlog is enabled without logging_collector
Log rotation failures due to unsupported destination
tuning_tips: Enable 'csvlog' only if logging_collector is on; combine destinations (e.g., 'stderr,csvlog') for redundancy and structured analysis; prefer 'syslog' for integration with enterprise log management.
